findings.title: Unused mutable reference binding prevents strict warning gate
findings.evidence: D3 Registry::start passes &mut ChannelWriter, &mut Ready<M>; no reference reassignment. Static warning inference, not compiler execution.
findings.fix: Remove only mut from channel binding; preserve exact-length body ownership.

findings.title: Default CSV UI uses rejected zero-based column
findings.evidence: Core ListColumnSelector::Index requires1..=16384; ordinary UI emits0.
findings.fix: Emit first-column1 and assert ordinary CSV consumer compatibility in authored regression.

findings.title: Explicit Lighthouse runtimeError is classified as success
findings.evidence: metrics ignores runtimeError and returns Some for any Lighthouse object; run maps Some to Success.
findings.fix: Typed failed/unavailable outcome for explicit runtime error, no raw message persistence; add200/runtimeError and all-metrics-missing countercases.

findings.title: Normalized URL cap is checked only inside already persisted job
findings.evidence: Preparation lacks <=8192 normalized-byte guard; validate_plan runs after App creates plan/input and registers worker. Raw Unicode path can expand beyond normalized limit.
findings.fix: Common preflight before store/admission/provider; preserve worker revalidation and add Unicode exact/+1 and zero-call refusal fixture.
